messages:
Maya: Need a razor-short one-pager for webinar attendees that compares deploy modes (security-forward) + 1 benchmark stat and 4 quick talking bullets. Can we get a draft by EOD Fri?

Eli: I’ll take the comparison table and SLA copy. Will keep it two rows: exec summary + details.

Noah: I’ll add the benchmark nugget. Suggest we surface p99 for a 2k seq on a production mix.

Priya: I’ll write the field-ready talking bullets (exec / platform / security / procurement) and the webinar CTA line.

Eli: Sketch for table: columns = Hosted | Dedicated | Private; rows = Latency (p99), Cost per 1M tokens, Control (network/KMS), SLA level.

Noah: Benchmark (raw):
```
Test run: model-mid, seq=2048, mixed prompt profile, 5k samples
Hosted p99 = 130ms, est $9 / 1M tokens
Dedicated p99 = 78ms, est $5.5 / 1M tokens (reserved infra)
Private p99 = 102ms, est $7 / 1M tokens (depends on infra)
```

Priya: Messaging bullets draft:
- Exec: "Choose the deployment that matches your risk profile — turnkey hosted or locked-down private, with consistent SLAs across both."
- Platform: "One API, same SDKs, deploy-mode toggle keeps dev velocity while enabling stricter controls."
- Security: "Private or Dedicated with KMS/HSM, VPC peering, and configurable audit retention windows."
- Procurement: "Pricing: pay-as-you-go (hosted), monthly reserved (dedicated), license+support for private."

Maya: Add a single line about fallback routing for resilience. Keep it non-technical  e.g., automatic fallbacks to maintain uptime.

Eli: Draft line: "Automatic routing policies keep apps online by falling back to the next-available compatible deployment when capacity or region limits are hit."

Priya: CTA: "Join our webinar replay + download the brief: [link placeholder] — book a demo for a 15-min infra walkthrough."

Design-bot: Visual asks: 3-column compact table, micro bar for p99 latency, tiny cost sparkline. Will need SVG data or mock values.

Maya: Ops/security checklist to include (one-liners): encryption at rest, KMS/HSM support, SOC2/ISO mention, per-route audit logs, and optional on-prem package.

Noah: Add footnote with test config: `model-mid, seq=2048, batch=24, synthetic replay` so field can cite it.

ops-bot: Reminder: include SOC2 compliance link when available  https://redwood.example.com/compliance/soc2 (placeholder).

Eli: I'll assemble the draft and post to the marketing board by tomorrow morning. Priya will then tweak tone for webinar audience.

Priya: Will add a short testimonial placeholder: "Cut inference cost X% vs. homegrown serving" and a tiny trust stat (devices in prod: N/A).

Maya: Good. Keep language concise — one-pager must read in <60s. If no blockers, we'll use as gated asset for webinar follow-up.

Noah: No blockers. Uploading benchmark sheet to GDrive after this.

Eli: No blockers.

Priya: No blockers.

Maya: Thanks team  will confirm final CTA once design passes mockups. :rocket:
